Cookies are stored client-side, so they can be easily added, removed, or altered by the client. An example of just how badly this can go wrong is if a website used cookies for authentication where the cookie value is the cleartext username. I log in, the website sends me a "userid" cookie with the value "something_went_wrong". Well, I just change that value to "Mokum" and suddenly the website thinks I'm you. You can imagine how much trouble I can then cause under your account.
